subject: Milan lose 0-2 at home to Ferencvaros; Amorim says his team was not mentally ready
title: Milan's two-nil night at San Siro

lines.vo: Milan had an extra man and still lost two-nil at home.
Both Ferencvaros goals came within fourteen minutes after half-time. Milan had the extra man from the seventy-seventh minute.
lines.footage: Lenny Joseph goals Ferencvaros San Siro

lines.vo: The first came after a mistake by backup keeper Lorenzo Torriani. Ouch. Lenny Joseph scored both.
Milan have three points from four Europa League games. That is twenty-eighth of thirty-six.
Ruben Amorim said his side were not mentally ready. He questioned his own preparation. A coach who blames the coach. Rare.
One Serie A defeat in ten games, but three European defeats in four. Amorim says Milan cannot yet do both. One competition at a time, then.
